findings.title: Concurrent-delete NPE remains in getSubGroupsStream overloads
findings.body: GroupAdapter.getSubGroupsCount was fixed to null-check modelSupplier.get(), but the three getSubGroupsStream overloads at lines 253-269 still do return modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) without a null check. If the group is deleted concurrently, modelSupplier.get() returns null and these methods still throw NullPointerException, so the concurrent-access fix is incomplete and listing/searching subgroups can still fail with 500.

findings.title: Reader thread never joined and can spin forever
findings.body: The test starts a raw new Thread that busy-loops while(!deletedAll.get()) issuing groups(null,0,Integer.MAX_VALUE,true) with no sleep, no stored reference, no join/timeout. deletedAll.set(true) is after the delete loop with no try-finally, so if any remove() throws the flag is never set and the thread loops forever hammering the server. Even on success the assertion runs without waiting for the reader thread to finish, so it is racy and the thread can leak into subsequent tests and grow caughtExceptions unboundedly.
